proposed_rules.trigger: A category/listing page whose main zone is nearly empty in the visual tree (a single large bg zone with little text), indicating a card/list grid that fell below the minWidth capture threshold or loads lazily.
proposed_rules.decision: Flag for Phase 2 targeted DOM extraction rather than concluding the page is empty. The zone is a listing block (cards/tiles), not a section background alone.
proposed_rules.rationale: minWidth capture collapses fine-grained list items; treating the zone as empty would drop the page's primary content.
